name: Cimballa (Spain)
description: A blue triangle at the hoist bearing a red embattled lozenge with two yellow concentric circles, the field of the bars of Aragon, with a blue triangle at the fly.
history: The flag is a cloth of proportion 2:3 of the Royal Sign of Aragon, enté azure at the hoist bearing a red embattled lozenge charged with two yellow concentric circles, and at the fly a blue triangle.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist
embattled lozenge bearing two yellow concentric circles
bars of Aragon on the field and circles on the lozenge
triangle with its base at the fly
